requirements.title: Pair 0 A forwarding
requirements.text: For pair 0 A, auto_out_0_a_valid and every auto_out_0_a_bits field equal the corresponding auto_in_0_a input. auto_in_0_a_ready equals auto_out_0_a_ready independently of valid. Every native opcode, param, size, source, address, mask, data and corrupt bit is preserved.

requirements.title: Pair 0 D forwarding
requirements.text: For pair 0 D, auto_in_0_d_valid and every auto_in_0_d_bits field equal the corresponding auto_out_0_d input. auto_out_0_d_ready equals auto_in_0_d_ready independently of valid. Every native opcode, param, size, source, sink, denied, data and corrupt bit is preserved.

requirements.title: Pair 1 A and D forwarding
requirements.text: Pair 1 independently forwards A valid and all A fields from auto_in_1 to auto_out_1, and A ready in the reverse direction. It forwards D valid and all D fields from auto_out_1 to auto_in_1, and D ready in the reverse direction. The preserved fields are opcode, param, size, source, address, mask, data and corrupt for A, and opcode, param, size, source, sink, denied, data and corrupt for D.

requirements.title: Pair 1 coherent side channels
requirements.text: Pair 1 forwards B valid, param and address from auto_out_1 to auto_in_1, and B ready in the reverse direction. It forwards C valid, opcode, param, size, source, address, data and corrupt from auto_in_1 to auto_out_1, and C ready in the reverse direction. It forwards E valid and sink from auto_in_1 to auto_out_1. E has no ready signal. Every field is preserved independently of other channels.

requirements.title: Combinational boundaries and reset
requirements.text: All 55 native outputs follow their corresponding current inputs combinationally, without a clock edge, queue, buffering, reordering or stored output. The same equalities hold for invalid and stalled channels and while reset is asserted. Reset does not gate valid, ready or payload. The two port pairs and all channels are independent. clock has no direct output-latency effect; active-high synchronous reset initializes and aborts only the legal-history checking described in the input domain.
